source: GeoNames CC BY 4.0 settlement points and IDs; Brunei Ministry of Home Affairs, Tel Aviv Municipality, Mongolia National Museum and city tourism, Taipei City Government, Israeli Knesset, UN Security Council, Palestinian President and selected per-period authorities.
selection: 25 distinct West Asian national/government/administrative seats or major historic cities plus previously unstaged East/Southeast Asian capitals; includes one Palestinian government-seat manual inclusion review outside the canonical low-population PPL threshold.
coordinateConvention: GeoNames contemporary WGS84 representative points only, not a historic city boundary or jurisdiction polygon.
countryCodeSemantics: Modern GeoNames countryCode identifies source metadata, not historical sovereignty, capital legitimacy or contested territorial recognition.
historicNameScope: Sources verify selected changes; unchanged-looking 1801 modern-name slots remain editorial baselines, not attested complete historical name continuity. Political/urban history and city ranks independent.
qualityNotes: All 25 current GeoNames IDs were separately checked for collisions with the 189 unique IDs from 19 existing batches; no overlap.
Tel Aviv-Yafo municipal history dates Ahuzat Bayit start 1909-04-11; 1910 committee used Tel Aviv. Separate old port Jaffa must not inherit modern new-town founding.
Brunei official Bandar Brunei -> Bandar Seri Begawan naming transition effective 1970-10-04.

Mongolian National Museum documents Niislel Khüree to Ulaanbaatar in 1924. Mongolian authority dates conflict on exact day, therefore fromYear 1924 only. Earlier moving capital sites not set equal to current coordinates.

Taipei Qing walled town completed 1884. 1895–1945 Japanese Taihoku and postwar Mandarin Taipei are documented as lasting civil naming choices, not battlefront occupancy; mainland China 1912 Korean Sino-reading rule is NOT applied to Taiwan.

Jerusalem Hebrew ירושלים and Arabic القدس kept as concurrent local names, not an inferred historic territorial ownership. Israeli domestic 1980 Basic Law, UN Security Council resolution 478 and Palestinian claim concerning East Jerusalem recorded separately.

Ramallah GeoNames PPL with 43,880 source population falls below original 50k PPL minimum; manual inclusion review is not a global candidate() override, final rank approval, or political capital designation.
Gaza city PPLA and Gaza Strip are distinct geographic objects. War damage does not auto-terminate or hide the urban record, population and temporal eligibility unresolved for present conflict.
Aden South Yemen capital historically distinct from Sanaa; 2026 de facto administrative control is not inferred from GeoNames PPLC status.

Single-entry cities have provisional 1801 language choices and await deeper source-by-era verification. No extrapolated exact-day renames, five-grade rank, old boundary polygons or historic sovereignty.
No place-runtime shards/manifest, main, app or previous 19 batch files were changed.

events.researchDetail: 1949년 이스라엘 정부가 예루살렘을 수도로 선언했다. 이 사건은 동서 예루살렘 전체의 국제법상 주권을 판정하지 않는다.
1980년 이스라엘의 수도 기본법은 해당 국가의 국내 법적 주장이다. 동예루살렘 귀속과 유엔의 결의가 별도로 존재한다.
안보리는 1980년 결의 478에서 이스라엘의 예루살렘 수도 기본법을 인정하지 않는다고 결정했다. 법정 명칭 개칭일이 아니다.
팔레스타인 대통령실은 2026-09-26 동예루살렘을 팔레스타인의 수도라고 재확인했다. 최초 주장 발생일로 해석하지 않는다.

displayTimeline.note: 몽골 국립박물관은 군주국 수도 지정과 Niislel
displayTimeline.researchNote: 몽골 국립박물관은 군주국 수도 지정과 Niislel Khüree 명칭을 확인한다. 1911년 독립과 1912년 법적 수도 지위 경계가 출처마다 달라 연도로만 기록한다.
